## Trying a flag on your own machine

Use Settings > Beta features to choose offered features on this machine. Cloud sessions additionally require a successful Access sign-in.

- Dev builds only: `chroFlags.force("<key>", true)` in the devtools console (`chroFlags.list()`, `.unforce()`, `.reset()`). Forces persist in localStorage. Release builds compile this out.
